content: Morning! What should today look like?

Your recovery signals through yesterday are stable—Form is **+7**, resting HR and HRV are steady, and sleep was 7.5 hours—so today can carry controlled intensity.

Warmup: 15min progressive Z1–Z2 (50–70% FTP)

Main: 3×12min sweet spot (88–94% FTP), 4min easy at 50–60% between

Cooldown: 10min Z1 (<55% FTP)

Estimated: **69min, Load ~65–70, Intensity ~0.78–0.80**

Keep it controlled, not maximal. If your legs feel unusually heavy during the warmup, switch the main set to easy Z2.
